statement: Least connections: when a request arrives, the load balancer checks which backend server has the fewest connections from the load balancer and forwards the request to it.

statement: The load balancer keeps track of how many active connections it has to each backend server; when a request completes its connection is freed, so a new request can go back to that server; each new request goes to the server with the fewest active connections.
